convert_instance_pose_to_pose_target: convert an InstancePose object to a PoseTarget using a specified convention class like ScaleShiftInvariant
convert_pose_target_to_instance_pose: convert a PoseTarget object back to an InstancePose using the PoseTargetConverter with the correct convention
create_invariant_pose_target: create an InvariantPoseTarget from an InstancePose to decouple scene scale from invariant quantities
apply_broadcast_postcompose_transform: apply a Transform3d postcomposition to batched scale, rotation, and translation tensors using _broadcast_postcompose
normalize_pose_with_log_scale_shift: normalize and denormalize pose values using LogScaleShiftNormalizer with configurable shift and scale log parameters
